comment: What mpc/build.py adds to gen_ui.py's skins. keys: the MPC has six function keys under the screen; each holds up to 8 pages (sub-tabs: pressing the key again shows its next page). The pages of mpc/ui.json in this order, a list per key. program: the Program Mode Q-Links (the knobs banked to the plugin rather than to a page), the 16 most-used parameters by name, Q-Link 1..16 (1 = bottom left, 13 = top left).
